D: Two kids find a board game that unleashes the jungle on their town, and the man trapped inside it for decades.
P: Serve the snacks when the monkeys wreck the kitchen.
S: the monkeys tearing through the kitchen
Ripe bananas in thick slices dipped in a batter of flour, sparkling water and a pinch of sugar, fried at 180C until puffed and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar.
everything comes charging through the house

Corn chips piled with spiced beans, melted cheese, salsa, sour cream and jalapeños. Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, spoon over 400g refried beans warmed with 1 tsp cumin and cover with 200g grated cheese.
the plants that take over the house
Pork and chive dumplings folded in wrappers, steamed 8 minutes in a bamboo basket lined with cabbage leaves, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dip.
M: the old Parrish house in a small New England town
Beef chuck seared, onion, carrot, celery and garlic, red wine and stock, braised at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes in for the last hour.
the hunter who comes out of the game
Venison backstrap rubbed with juniper, pepper and thyme, seared to rare, rested, with a red wine and redcurrant sauce and root vegetable mash.
W: Brantford, New Hampshire in the fall
Soft creamy fudge made with real maple syrup, cut into little squares. Boil 250ml maple syrup, 200g brown sugar, 150ml cream and 40g butter to 115C, stirring gently.
K: a New Hampshire autumn in Brantford
Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, served warm in mugs.

s.note: the monkeys tearing through the kitchen
s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 200ml sparkling water and a pinch of sugar. Dip thick slices of 4 bananas and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Roll in 80g sugar mixed with cinnamon while hot.

s.note: everything comes charging through the house
s.how: Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, spoon over 400g refried beans warmed with 1 tsp cumin and cover with 200g grated cheese. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes and top with 200g salsa, 150g sour cream and jalapeños.

m.note: the hunter who comes out of the game
m.how: Rub 800g venison backstrap with crushed juniper, pepper and thyme. Sear to rare and rest. Add 150ml red wine and 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly to the pan and reduce. Mash 600g parsnips and 400g potatoes with butter.

w.note: Brantford, New Hampshire in the fall
w.how: Boil 250ml maple syrup, 200g brown sugar, 150ml cream and 40g butter to 115C, stirring gently. Cool 10 minutes, then beat until thick and losing its gloss. Spread in a lined 15cm tin, cool and cut into squares.

d.note: a New Hampshire autumn in Brantford
d.how: Warm 1L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and 3 strips orange peel over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and serve hot.
